# Pulse task #2866: Reflect Arrange time selections in the open clip editor

Operation: 26f6b0fd3132531eaa011226d3b840f0
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User19October2026: when a time selection is active in Arrange, reflect it in the clip editor so the same musical time range is visible there. Related new2864 adds explicit Zoom to Fit/Back andZ/X;2865 prevents range gestures from switching toDevice view. Duplicate live time-selection/clip-editor searches found no matching focused issue; existing14/38 canonical time selection and2117 panel-focus history remain distinct.

Map the authoritative Arrange range into the currently displayed audio/MIDI clip editor using the actual clip placement/source/beat-time transformation, not the same numeric frame values in two different coordinate domains. Highlight the corresponding overlapping range consistently through drag/update/commit/reversed selection and tempo/clip-offset changes. For a range spanning multipleclips/tracks, show the current displayed clip's applicable intersection without choosing another track/device or fabricating out-of-clip editable media. Empty/nonoverlap/stale clip/project must show a truthful cleared/nonapplicable reflected range and must not alter content. Inspect actual loop/Warp/nonzero-offset/ArrangementClip placement contracts; don't duplicate mapping formulas or infer every source time equals timeline time. Original local clip-editor selection/edit gestures keep their own correct focus/routing; this request is Arrange→currenteditor reflection, not an unrequested bidirectional editing system.

Optional display policy question was asked: highlight only versus autozoom every Arrange selection. Pending any later user answer, default to reflected highlight with explicit2864 ZoomtoFit/Z for zooming; do not silently force repeated viewport jumps while drawing a range. Ensure the reflected range can be fitted by the same selected-range zoom action. If the user elects autozoom, update this exact ticket freshly and qualify bounded viewport synchronization; no second ticket/implementation. This default can be refined before implementation without blocking unrelated work.

Preserve explicit pane open/closed intent and2865 noDeviceautoswitch; don't open a closed pane or switchDevice→Clip just to reflect invisible state. Preserve current detail owner, text/IME/numeric-draft/finalization barriers, grid/snap selection bounds and zero musical history edits. Reflection changes view state only: no note/audio trim/bounce/loop/playhead/project mutation. Avoid stale worker-state reapplication after range clear/project/clip replacement; reuse existing canonicalrange/event/viewprojection architecture, no global sync owner/framework.

Acceptance actual rendered Arrange gesture→sameaudio/MIDIeditor range, reverse/extend/cancel/clear, nonzero clipstart/sourceoffset, relevant tempo/warp/loop mapping, multi-clip intersection/nooverlap, switching/deleting/replacing clip/project, live async state updates and focus/closedpanel preservation. Assert mappedinterval andpaintedhighlight plus unchanged musicalcontent/history; reflectedrange works with2864fit. Relevant focused local UI/model mapping checks then solemerger current exact qualification/review/merge. Readyonlyactualmerge; Root optimizednative checklist separate. No app/native/install/quit/hostedCI.

Existing general UI worker queues after current310/455/newresize work, alongside2864/2865;onewriter/3workers. Supportedcanonicalintake/attach/sourceidentity beforeimplementation; return actual unresolved cross-domain contract toRoot rather than inventing mapping.
